intro.title: useFetch
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular component that fetches and displays a list of users from a public API. You will learn how to use Angular's HttpClient to make HTTP GET requests and handle the response data. The core concept involves managing asynchronous operations using Observables and the async pipe in the template. By the end, you'll understand how to fetch data, handle loading and error states, and render it in your Angular application.
intro.usecase: The useFetch pattern is essential for handling data loading in real-world Angular applications. You'll use it in dashboard components to display live metrics from APIs, in e-commerce product listings to fetch inventory data, and in admin panels to load user information. This pattern helps manage loading states, errors, and data caching while keeping your components clean and maintainable when working with external data sources.
